request: Create a configurable cat magnet pin in a new preset: a flat cat head about 30 mm across and 4 mm thick, with a press-fit pocket for a 10 × 2 mm disc magnet in its back that does not go through.

steps:
const p = await presets.create({ title: 'Cat magnet pin', about: 'a cat-head pin with a press-fit pocket for a 10 × 2 mm magnet', files: { 'script.js': "// A cat-head pin with a press-fit pocket for a disc magnet in its back.
return j.part('cat')
  .params({ head: mm(30), t: mm(4), mag_d: mm(10), mag_h: mm(2) })
  .expose(['head', 't', 'mag_d', 'mag_h'])
  .extrude(
    j.region.circle('head / 2')
      .union(j.region.polygon([[-14, 4], [-12, 18], [-3, 13]]))
      .union(j.region.polygon([[14, 4], [12, 18], [3, 13]])),
    't', { id: 'head' })
  .add(j.lib.magnet({ d: 'mag_d', h: 'mag_h' }), { at: j.tx.move(0, 0, 't'), op: 'cut', id: 'magnet' })
", 'notes.md': '# Cat magnet pin

A 30 mm cat head, 4 mm thick, with a press-fit pocket for a 10 × 2 mm magnet in its back.
' } });
const r = await run(); return { id: p.id, ok: r.ok, errors: r.errors, volume: r.ok ? program.metrics('volume').volume : null };
oracle.answer: Created U-01 · Cat magnet pin: a 30 mm cat head (a circle and two ears), 4 mm thick, with params head, t, mag_d and mag_h; j.lib.magnet cuts a Ø10.20 × 2.20 mm press-fit pocket into its back, leaving 1.8 mm in front.
